description: The three SET endpoints plus an isolated pytest suite with mock seed data. SET-1 settings read/update and SET-2 patient profile read/update both live in features/settings/router.py; SET-3 GET /dashboard lives in features/dashboard/router.py. Depends on FEAT-001 (config, constants, schema, connection+migrate, dependencies, seed). Tests run against a temp DB (never storage/echovault.db) and assert the engagement-only dashboard constraint explicitly.
steps: SET-1 in backend/app/features/settings/router.py: create an APIRouter. `GET /settings` (readable by patient OR caregiver via get_role) returns ALL four keys as PARSED JSON (game_topics, game_difficulty, trivia_frequency_min, quiet_hours), reading rows from the settings table (json.loads the value column) and falling back to constants.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS for any MISSING key — never empty, never 404. `PUT /settings` (depends on require_caregiver, body `payload: dict = Body(...)`) validates the SHAPE of each provided key then upserts it as a JSON string into settings keyed by key: game_topics = list whose every element is in constants.ALLOWED_GAME_TOPICS (reject unknown topic); game_difficulty = int in 1..3; trivia_frequency_min = positive int (>0); quiet_hours = object with 'start' and 'end' each matching ^\d{2}:\d{2}$ and a valid 00-23 hour / 00-59 minute. Invalid shapes -> HTTP 400 with a clear message. Keep a tiny inline settings repository returning dict(row) / parsed values.

SET-2 in the SAME file backend/app/features/settings/router.py (per DELEGATION/README.md): `GET /patient` (readable by patient OR caregiver) returns the single patient row as dict(row), or a documented empty object / null body if not yet created (NOT 404, so the patient app can boot pre-setup). `PUT /patient` (require_caregiver) upserts the single row with id=1 using INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE (or INSERT OR REPLACE pinned to id=1) so there is NEVER a second row. Accept full_name, preferred_name, birth_date, photo_path, language, font_scale, voice_enabled, managed_mode. Validate language in constants.LANGUAGES ({fil,en,fil-en}) -> 400 otherwise; require full_name when creating. Set updated_at via datetime('now','localtime').

SET-3 in backend/app/features/dashboard/router.py: `GET /dashboard` (require_caregiver) returns FULL LISTS of rows (not counts) for every ARCHITECTURE section 10 bullet: unverified_memories = memories WHERE trust='unverified' (includes source='ai_suggested'); conflicting_pairs = memories WHERE trust='conflicting' AND conflicts_with IS NOT NULL, deduped so each pair appears once (e.g. order id < conflicts_with, or collect both rows per pair); outdated_memories = memories WHERE trust='outdated' AND updated_at >= datetime('now','localtime','-7 days'); medication_attention = medication_logs WHERE status='skipped' OR (status='unconfirmed' AND due_at < datetime('now','localtime')), joined to medication name/dose; flagged_answers = assistant_log WHERE flagged=1; activity_summary = aggregated activity_log reported as ENGAGEMENT ONLY — counts of played vs skipped grouped by activity and by topic (e.g. {activity, topic, played_count, skipped_count}) where played = outcome in ('completed','correct','incorrect','stopped') and skipped = outcome 'skipped'. The response MUST NOT contain any score, rating, percentage, accuracy, or separate correct/incorrect field anywhere. Add a comment citing PRODUCT.md and ARCHITECTURE sections 10/11 as the hard constraint. Return every row via dict(row).
Finalize router registration in backend/app/main.py if FEAT-001 left it as import-only: ensure the settings and dashboard routers are registered on the app.

Write backend/tests/conftest.py: a pytest fixture that builds a FRESH temp SQLite DB per test (temp file via tmp_path, or :memory: with a single shared connection), runs migrate() then seed() on it, overrides the app's get_db dependency (and config DB path) to use that temp DB, and yields a FastAPI TestClient. Provide helpers for patient headers ({'X-Role':'patient'}) and caregiver headers ({'X-Role':'caregiver','X-Caregiver-Id': <seeded active caregiver id>}). NEVER touch storage/echovault.db.

Write backend/tests/test_settings.py: GET /settings returns all four keys as parsed JSON with defaults when unset; caregiver PUT persists and round-trips via a follow-up GET; invalid shapes each return 400 — game_difficulty 0, 4 and 'two'; quiet_hours non-HH:MM; quiet_hours missing start or end; unknown game_topic; non-positive trivia_frequency_min; patient GET succeeds; patient PUT returns 403. Add a DoD-boundary test (with a comment that games/trivia routers are intentionally OUT of scope) asserting the settings values games/trivia WOULD read are persisted and retrievable after a caregiver update.

Write backend/tests/test_patient_profile.py: PUT /patient to create then PUT again to update, asserting SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient == 1 after both (never a second row); invalid language -> 400; a valid language ('fil','en','fil-en') accepted; patient GET /patient succeeds; patient PUT /patient -> 403.

Write backend/tests/test_dashboard.py: with the seeded mock data, GET /dashboard as caregiver returns the expected rows in every section (>=1 unverified incl. the ai_suggested one; the conflicting pair present; the outdated memory present; the medication needing attention present; the flagged answer present; activity_summary non-empty). Assert the activity_summary shape EXPLICITLY contains none of the keys: 'score','rating','percentage','accuracy','correct','incorrect' (check every summary entry). GET /dashboard as patient -> 403.

Write backend/tests/test_roles.py: a request with a missing X-Role to a require_caregiver endpoint -> 403; an unknown X-Role -> 403; a caregiver request with an unknown or inactive X-Caregiver-Id -> 403.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && pytest` passes every test with no failures or errors.
GET /settings returns the four keys parsed from JSON and falls back to SETTINGS_DEFAULTS for missing keys (asserted in test_settings.py).
Each invalid settings shape (bad game_difficulty, non-HH:MM quiet_hours, unknown game_topic, non-positive frequency) returns 400 (asserted in test_settings.py).
After two PUT /patient calls, patient row count is exactly 1 (asserted in test_patient_profile.py); invalid language -> 400.

GET /dashboard returns full lists for all six sections and the activity_summary has no score/rating/percentage/accuracy/correct/incorrect field (asserted in test_dashboard.py); patient GET /dashboard -> 403.
Missing/unknown X-Role -> 403 and unknown/inactive X-Caregiver-Id -> 403 (asserted in test_roles.py).
verification: python -c "from app.main import app; print('import ok')"  (app still imports after endpoints added)

Fresh temp-DB check: python -c "import sqlite3; from app.database import connection as cx; from app.database import seed; c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; cx.migrate(c); seed.seed(c); seed.seed(c); assert c.execute('select count(*) from patient').fetchone()[0]==1; print('ok')"
Remove any temp files created during manual verification.
findings: FEAT-002 complete. 24 tests pass (pytest), app imports, fresh temp-DB double-migrate+double-seed keeps patient count at 1, and no storage/echovault.db is created during tests. Integration/review notes: (1) Added backend/pytest.ini (pythonpath=., testpaths=tests) so the `app` package imports when running pytest from backend/ — if a repo-wide pytest config is later introduced, keep backend root on sys.path. (2) Tests use a shared :memory: connection with check_same_thread=False (Starlette TestClient runs endpoints in a worker thread) and a plain TestClient WITHOUT the `with` block so the startup event (which migrates the real config.DB_PATH) never fires — do not switch to `with TestClient(app)` without re-pointing config.DB_PATH to a temp path first. (3) Endpoints added onto the existing router objects; main.py already includes both routers (no change needed). (4) SET-1 PUT /settings validates only keys present in the payload (partial updates allowed) and rejects unknown keys/shapes with 400; game_difficulty and trivia_frequency_min explicitly reject bool (int subclass). (5) SET-2 PUT /patient upserts id=1 (INSERT when absent, UPDATE when present), requires full_name only on create, validates language against constants.LANGUAGES; GET /patient returns {} (not 404) pre-setup. (6) SET-3 GET /dashboard returns FULL ROW LISTS; conflicting_pairs deduped via id < conflicts_with (one entry per pair); medication_attention = skipped OR past-due unconfirmed, joined to medication name/dose as medication_name/medication_dose; activity_summary groups by (activity, topic) with played_count/skipped_count ONLY — a test asserts none of score/rating/percentage/accuracy/correct/incorrect appear. (7) outdated_memories uses updated_at >= datetime('now','localtime','-7 days'); seed sets the outdated row's updated_at to now, so it stays in-window. (8) Games/trivia routers remain out of scope; the settings-persistence DoD-boundary test (test_settings.py::test_settings_persistence_dod_boundary) covers the storage boundary instead. (9) Two DeprecationWarnings about FastAPI on_event come from FEAT-001's main.py and are unrelated to FEAT-002.
